segments.an3.146:1.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an3.146:1.3: Akusalena kāyakammena, akusalena vacīkammena, akusalena manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an3.146:2.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an3.146:2.3: Kusalena kāyakammena, kusalena vacīkammena, kusalena manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.

lines: 147-155. Pañcamassa paṭhame yathābhataṃ nikkhittoti yathā ānetvā ṭhapito.
